balls.text: full quick ball angling into Green. He fails to get under it totally but still manages to smack it to long on's right. However the fielder runs to his right, puts in a dive, and this time it is taken. Curran helps PBKS finish on a semi-high as RCB finish on 241 for 7
thigh-high full toss around off as Harshal returns bowling from over the stumps. Mistimed slap square for a single

Harshal moves to No. 1 on the purple cap list as Lomror's off-stump gets knocked back. Dipping slower-ball yorker, with the line closer to off stump this time. Lomror swings across the line, ball sneaks under the bat, and the bails get splayed
overpitched ball wider outside off stump. Drilled to deep extra cover

around the stumps to left-hander Lomror. Starts off with a slower-ball yorker that goes under Lomror's bat and hits him low on the feet. LBW appeal turned down as the umpire not interested but PBKS review. Is it missing leg stump? Did the angle from around the wicket make it tough to get the LBW? Yes, for both.
hurries onto Karthik and it hits him high on the bat. Harshal cranks his pace up, bowls short around off and he is too slow to get in position for the pull. Sliced to Curran lurking near long on
caught at deep extra cover! But it is a free hit and DK also gets to keep strike. Half-tracker outside off and slapped with the turn without much risk in the air

Dropped by Rossouw! Chahar bowls full around off and Karthik goes for the slog sweep again. Rossouw runs in from the deep to take a low catch since the timing is not great, however the ball goes under his hands, and goes to the boundary on the bounce. What's worse, Chahar has overstepped.
Chahar bowling from closer to the crease. Length ball outside off and Green under-edges the cut, getting it behind Bairstow
DK moves to the off side exposing all three stumps. Chahar bowls full on middle and off. DK sweeps to Harshal at short fine leg, who makes a smart stop to keep it down to just one
clobbered over deep midwicket! Today the Chahar idea is not working out. Full ball outside off. No spin this time. DK gets low, down on one knee, and then smacks the spinner for half a dozen
swings across the line and mistimed to square leg
laced down the ground, beating Livingstone at long off! Chahar bowls a length ball outside off and the legbreak works to Green's advantage. Slapped to long off's left
full and wide ball outside off. Karthik brings out the Nidahas Trophy shot out of the bag, and sends Arshdeep over wide long off for six! Steps to the off side slightly before executing the shot
DK welcomed with a short-ish ball that hits him on the chest as he misses the pull.

dropped on 0, dropped on 10, caught on 92! Chasing his 100th hundred in all formats and only eight runs away from the IPL's 100th hundred, Virat Kohli falls at deep extra cover. Arshdeep went full and wide and Kohli sliced this shot well, perhaps too well! Flies into the hands of Rossouw few metres inside the boundary line and Kohli must go. Kohli swings the bat around his head like a lasso to acknowledge the crowd's response
full ball outside off stump. Too wide again, and left alone

oh that's marvellous! If this was 2003, you'd have said Kohli's bat had a spring! Back of a length ball outside off. Kohli wields his bat like a sword and scythes an uppercut from near his body, sending the ball over backward point for six

small margins! Arshdeep around the stumps again, and he bowls full outside off, but misses the length by a few inches, and that's enough for Kohli to caress a drive through the covers. Beats long off running to his left!
Arshdeep around the stumps. Kohli comes down the track and pins this full ball straight back. In fact too straight! Crashes into middle stump at the bowler's end. Four runs robbed!
yorker length ball outside off. Digs this away to the off side for a single. Team 200 up!
full ball around off. Green crunches this right back towards Harshal, who sticks his left hand out to stop the ball. Good effort on the followthrough
full ball outside off. Kohli tries to go up and over cover but slices the shot slightly. Lands well in front of the fielder at deep extra cover, so it is safe
overpitched ball, landing outside the tram-lines and almost in front of Bairstow! Umpire Nitin Menon says wide
slower ball, yorker attempted around off and middle, but ends up as a low full toss. Mistimed to the off side
high into the night sky before landing near the sightscreen. Harshal goes full and slightly wide. Green puts his long levers to good use by reaching forward and getting the elevation on that one
bit of luck as Green gets one away to third man for four. Short and wide, and Green was through his attempted cut way too early

Kohli brings up Curran's fifty! Slightly straighter this time, smacking the bowler right over his head. Full ball outside off, takes the pace off, but Kohli was waiting for the slower ball once again. Clubbed!
miscued towards mid off as Green tries to go too hard at this shot
much needed four off Green's bat! Full ball on middle stump. Green keeps a steady head and plays a shot through the ball's line. Lofted over the umpire straight down.
slower ball, on a good length on middle. Kohli lets it get across before punching to wide long off for a single
full and wide again. In fact, wider! Kohli doesn't blink, and collects another extra for his side
full and wide outside off. Kohli sticks the bat out but brings it ack in late. Ball goes over the tram-lines, and RCB collect a wide
oh that's big, massive! Almost as if Kohli was waiting for the slower-ball that lands on a slot. Only 99kph, and Kohli waited, waited, and waited before smacking Curran over cow corner
full ball outside off and crunched towards cover's left, but the fielder swiftly moves to his left to intercept
back of a length ball outside off. Goes deep in his crease and flat-bats to long off. Time out
perfectly hit slog sweep! Bit of extra air from Livingstone. Kohli's eyes lit up, and he took a big stride forward, before smacking it over the leg side
full ball on middle. Driven to long off for a single
attempts a top spinner. Length ball on middle, and skidding on while gathering extra bounce. Kohli plays a late dab to short third for a single
full ball outside leg stump. Clipped to deep midwicket
full ball on leg. Green hangs back and punches it back to Livingstone
change-up ball. Full outside off and Green flat-bats a bashed shot past Patel's left. Long off is quite straight, aiding the bowler on this occasion
up and over but on the bounce to the fielder at deep extra cover. Back of a length ball outside off and Kohli slaps this one over the infield. In the air briefly
full ball on middle stump and driven to long on for a single
back of a length ball outside off. But the tall Green gets on top of it and cuts it amazingly behind point for four! Hits it onto the side pitches, getting extra bounce over the infielder
tries another yorker while taking the pace off. Ends up as a low full toss. Flicked to deep midwicket
slower ball yorker on off and middle, released from wide of the crease. Toe-ends a bunt down the ground to long on for one

slog swept over the midwicket fielder and in the gap again! Full ball on middle and off. Kohli chooses to stay aggressive, and gets it over the infielder by a little bit. Timing not 100% but the intent was there

fifty in 32 balls! Shouts of "Kohli, Kohli" from the crowd as Livingstone jogs in. Full ball around leg and he plays a trademark flick through the midwicket region, lifting his back leg up while completing the shot. His sixth 50+ score of the season!
full ball on off and he takes a big stride in before driving down to long on
slows it down. Full ball around off. This one turns in, leaving Kohli in an awkward position trying to play the late cut.  Uncomfortably guided to the off side
nearly caught and bowled! Full ball outside off and Green hits it right back past the bowler's left. Liam dived full stretch to try and catch it, but couldn't get anything to it
full ball on off and driven back to the bowler
another drive drilled with the turn. But stopped at cover on this occasion
full ball on off. Kohli stays leg-side of the delivery and drills a drive through the covers. Beats the diving fielder, adding to the work off the long-off fielder running around the boundary line
overpitched ball around off. Driven to long on for a single. Toe-ended slightly but manages to rotate strike
shorter ball. Skidding onto Green with the batter making room towards the leg side. Bunted to midwicket
in the gap! Tosses it up outside off. Turning away. Green commits to a drive and hits it off the bat's outside half, sending it between the two fielders at deep extra cover and long off
full ball wider outside off. Slapped with the turn to deep extra cover
only six off the over as this overpitched ball is driven towards extra cover. Overthrow allows them another run
full ball outside off stump. Pushed with the turn to cover
full ball just outside off. Bit of turn away, past Kohli's edge with the batter probing with his bat. Kohli smiles in surprise
full ball around off. Too full and too close to his body for the cut. Mistimed to the off side
skiddy one sliding down leg with Kohli trying a sweep
tossed up outside off. Turning away. Green drives away from his body to deep extra cover
full toss outside leg. Punches this knee-high delivery to long on for a single. Wet ball causing the full toss?
smart catch from Bairstow as Curran pushes it full and wide again. Patidar reaches out to guide one behind point, but got a thick edge on this occasion. Out for a smart 55
lands safe at cow corner despite deep midwicket and long on lurking. Kohli drags this shot high up in the air
full ball outside off and driven to cover off the bat's toe end

over the vacant fine leg region! Curran tries to test him with the short ball. But Patidar commits to the pull, and even though he's top-edged it, he has done it safely. Gets to fifty in 21 balls - his fourth of the season!
fullish ball around leg stump. Comes down the track  and whips it to long on
smartly guided! Pierces the gap behind square on the off side, reaching out and guiding a boundary between short third and backward point. Curran errs by going too full
full and wide ball. Patidar times a checked drive with exquisite timing in front of square, but Ashutosh hares around the boundary line and puts in a dive at deep extra cover to stop a definite four
played to deep extra cover and the man at deep point has some running around to do to keep it down to just one
full ball angling across and Patidar loses grip on one hand, mistiming a shot to the off side while reaching out to play it
Arshdeep tries to keep it away from Patidar's reach. Ends up bowling a wide

shot of the day! Short of good length ball on leg. Not short enough to trouble Patidar. He stays deep in his crease before confidently pulling Arshdeep over wide long on for six. He got into position so early there
back of a length ball on middle. Guided to short third for a single
starts the over with four! Pulled with disdain, rolling his wrists over the shot to keep it grounded. Back of a good length ball from around the stumps on this occasion. 50 partnership in 21 balls
length ball angling into Patidar and brushes his pads as he tries to get out of the way
the spin basher is bashing spin! Full ball, loopy and landing outside off. Turning away and Patidar launches into a big shot, smacking Chahar over wide long off!
length ball, sixth-stump line, and Patidar just lets it go
dropped by the keeper! But tough chance to be fair. Length ball outside off and Patidar tried to cut. Ended up hitting it towards the keeper
another quick one, good length ball around off. Swivels and pulls squarer this time, making use of the footwork to send the ball over square leg
half-tracker around off. Stands back and pulled over wide long on! Quickly got onto Patidar but he managed to put it away nonetheless.
Kaverappa finishes with 2-36 on debut. Could've actually had five today. Full ball on middle, and clipped to midwicket for a dot. Do Punjab Kings replace him right away with an impact player?!
length ball around off and nurdled off his body to the leg side for a quick single
back of a length ball around off stump. Gently bunted to the leg side for a quick run
clobbered over wide long on! Full ball angling into his pads. Patidar picks it up off his shin, and smacks it past the long-on fielder riding the boundary line
driven to the off side for a single
one-handed six over long off! Pure timing there from Kohli, picking this fullish ball by reaching out, losing grip off one hand, but that makes no difference to the result
full ball on a fifth-stump line. This one zips through with the batter trying to drive. Through to Bairstow and that's time out
slot ball, pace-on delivery, just outside off. Perfect spot for Patidar in the powerplay, and he presses forward before driving past Harshal for four down the ground
good length ball on off. Not short enough to pull. Patidar swivels to pull but scythes a mistimed shot to mid on
steered fine! Good length ball just outside off. Patidar hangs back and drops his hands very late, successfully playing a late glance past short third's left
full ball on middle. Easy pickings for Patidar as he closes his bat's face to a 45-degree angle, and then guides it through midwicket for a teasing chase to the boundary line
124kph full ball just outside off. Toe-ends this back to the bowler

dropped again! A third drop by the Punjab fielders in the powerplay and a third chance down for the rookie Kaverappa! Cruel for the youngster. He bowls a back of length ball angling into Patidar, who tries to hook it towards deep backward square, but ends up dragging it to fine leg instead. Harshal, on the boundary line, runs forward to take the catch, but unbelievably, he fluffs this one too.
length ball on middle. Clipped to the leg side

change of pace from the fast bowler does the trick! Rolls his wrists while delivering this. Bowls full around leg, and Jacks tries to clip it over backward square leg, but ends up dragging the shot more towards short fine leg. Smart work from Harshal moving to his left and another reward for the bowler for his back-bending effort
good length ball angling into him with the batter making room. Cramps him up, and through to the keeper
flicked towards deep backward square leg after coming down the track. Think he wanted to play that in front of square

rubbing salt on Kaverappa's wounds! Curran gives the rookie a third over in the powerplay, and goes full just outside off. This time Kohli gets timing, placement, and elevation as he hammers him over long off for six
full ball on off. This is the cutter. Jacks toe-ends a shot back to Curran who falls while trying to stop it. Ball hits his, leg an ricochets to the leg side
that's more like it! Slot ball, just outside off. Jacks clears the front leg, trusts the bounce off this surface, and swings the bat through the ball's line to deposit a six over long on
puts his countryman away for another four Jacks tries to launch a shot through the off side but the bat's face turns in his hand and gets a shot away to midwicket instead
Curran overpitches on middle. Kohli backs away and converts it into a full toss. Driven to deep extra cover
trademark dropkick over midwicket! Fullish ball around leg. Kohli dances down the track, picks this pace-off ball early, and then flicks his wrists to swipe a shot over midwicket
good length ball around off stump. Too close to his body for an attempted punch through the off side. Ends up inside edging towards square leg

dropped at cover! This is Rossouw. Tough chance but Kaverappa misses out on Kohli's wicket for the second time. Slot ball outside off and Kohli absolutely creamed this cover drive. It was straight towards the fielder but the speed of the ball courtesy Kohli's timing has saved him.

surprised Kohli with the bounce there. Bends his back and bowls one into the pitch. Short and wide outside off. Kohli tries to knock it to the leg side from outside off, but he's surprised by the extra bounce. Ends up awkwardly bunting the ball to the off side
fullish ball, bit wider outside off stump. Pushed to cover, gently on this occasion
good length ball wider outside off stump. Tries to punch away from his body first ball but some extra bounce takes an inside edge to the leg side

There's his maiden wicket! Gets some extra bounce with this short and wide ball. Du Plessis tries to slap it over extra cover but ends up slicing it more towards deep point. Boundary rider makes no mistake
full ball outside off stump. Bit of movement away as the batter considers driving. Half-attempt from Faf. Through ton the keeper

falls a few metres over mid off! Kohli gets forward to a full ball but doesn't commit to the loft, ending up chipping a shot. Had enough to clear the infielder after teasing PBKS for a bit, but not enough to get the boundary

stand and deliver! Length ball angling across again. But Kohli stands tall, keeps a still head, and reaches out to play an exquisite drive through the covers. More like a punch, instead of the kind where he leans in
good length ball angling across from Kohli. Great movement away with Kohli trying to poke at it. Through to Bairstow, who is behind the stumps in Jitesh's absence
full ball on middle, and shaping into his pads. Flicks it with the bat's closed face to deep backward square leg
full ball around off. Bit of shape into Kohli. Crunches a drive rather well, but straight to mid off
length ball angling across. Knocked to the off side for a single

and that's another, courtesy a misfield. Full ball, bit wider outside off. Du Plessis hammers a grounded drive through cover, but straight to the fielder. However such is the pace of the ball is that it bursts through his grasp for four more.
du Plessis is off! Full ball just outside off. A trademark shuffle of the bat before bringing the bat through the ball's line to drive it past the covers for four
short of good length ball just outside off. Through to the keeper

what a moment that would've been for Kaverappa!  Full ball just outside off and a bit of movement away. Kohli plays a false stroke while attempting to hit it through the on-side again, and the ball goes high up over cover point.  Ashutosh runs to take a tough catch from point but then can't grab it. Dropped
full ball around off. Comes down the track and tries to be aggressive. Attempts to hammer a shot through mid-on's right but misses as the ball jags away after pitching.
one slip to Kohli. Full ball on middle stump and driven down the V to mid on.

plinked to mid-on, it's red rover for PBKS! A limp swipe and the ball nearly dies on Karn Sharma has he stumbles in to complete the catch. Doesn't need to be perfect, because the scorecard already looks good for RCB - victors by 60 runs
full and wide, Arshdeep pokes it through backward point! Stepped outside leg, came right off the toe of the bat and deep third can't get around
short outside off, Arshdeep swipes it into the ground to short midwicket
fired down at 144kph and wheeched out into the leg side
beats the big heave to leg! Siraj was aiming for the top of off, missed by a whisker
bouncer, 139kph and over the flailing bat of the No. 11. DK can't hold it, either, and they sneak an extra to go with the wide

full and flicked... straight to the man back! Harshal picks out deep backward square leg, well held by Ferguson as he steadied himself out by the rope. Golden duck for Harshal and this goose is almost fully cooked
short, wide and slashed! Chahar frees the arms and clobbers a boundary through backward point
short ball with pace on, swing and a miss
back of a length, 135kph on off stump, blocked

kerrrrrrrr-splat! Off stump out of the ground, RCB closing in. Superbly bowled by Ferguson, who rocks out what looks like a fiendish legcutter that dips and grips to beats Curran's swing on the inside and send Kings' captain on his way
short and it flies off the edge! Pace on from Ferguson and that results in a boundary to deep third for Curran
back of a length on the stumps and flicked through midwicket

full, straight, hit on the pads... up goes the finger but Ashutosh reviews. No bat involved, I think, but it may be tight on hitting leg stump. Ball-tracking will have the final say, only has to be clipping. Ashutosh seems to have had his mind made up already and starts to walk, as the projection returns "umpire's call". Niton Menon repeats the dose and Kings' last hope heads to the dressing room
length ball on the stumps, 140kph and clipped out to deep midwicket
short and veering away wide of Curran's off stump
back of a length, pace off and tapped down into the covers
short and shoveled into the second tier! Ashutosh rocks on to the back foot and helps the ball up and away, 80m over fine leg for his first boundary
full toss, Curran twocks it down to long-on
length ball punched down the ground
back of a length into the body, nudged behind square
on the body and worked to leg for one

tucked into the leg side, they are pushing hard for two more... Kohli tears in and underarms into the stumps, and RCB are celebrating! Shashank is inches short here! Just as with Rossouw, he is dismissed the ball after requiring treatment for an injury! He walks off less than gruntled, and Kings are sinking. Kohli with the magic in the field, and boy doesn't he enjoy those moments. Hared in from deep midwicket, pounced and threw into the ground while in midair, then celebrated like a boss as the replays confirmed the dsmissal!
into the pitch, 133kph and nurdled towards deep midwicket. Good running gets them two
dug in, Shashank walks across and aims a big blow across the line... ends up wearing the ball on the body
back of a length, 137kph on the stumps, Curran tucks it for one
slashed and this will run away! A streaky shot brings Shashank four more, as the ball spins away from short third
shortish length, swatted down to long-on
nicely bowled, dragged down as Curran looks to come out. Karn then scampers across to his left to field
flat on leg stump, 89kph and flicked through midwicket. They take a second on Lomror's misfield
shorter length, skidding through at 93kph. Flicked through backward square leg
belted into the crowd, Shashank looking to prove Vishwas's point! Tossed up on the stumps and he launches a slog-sweep over deep square leg, 87m six
darted into the pitch and Curran crashes a cut... can't beat du Plessis in the covers, though
fired wide of off, 96kph and mistimed towards extra cover
short and battered through cow! The ball sits up nicely for the pull, Curran pinging it past short midwicket and away for four
bowled into the pitch, angling across and room to swing the arms. Cut firmly but well stopped in the deep by Green

leading edge to cover, another one goes! Livingstone closes the face looking to turn the ball to leg and merely sends a looping catch into the off side. Swapnil gets his second of the night and it is looking increasingly like curtains for PBKS
zipped down on the stumps, 96kph and nudged to leg
tossed up and defended pressing forwards

bowled 'im! Ripping legbreak, hits the top of off. Karn roars and punches the air in celebration - and why not? It was a lovely bit of bowling. Pitched on a length around leg stump and spinning sharply across the bows as Jitesh went for the big ole slog over the leg side
flatter, straighter and tapped into the covers
full and sliced over short third, not where Jitesh was aiming but it clears two fielders and spins away
shovelled off the hip through square
monstered over deep midwicket! Drops short again and Shashank heaves it a loooooooooooooong way up. Just has the distance to drop over the rope
lobbed up, spinning a touch on the stumps and nudged leg side
steps out and muscles the ball back, was that a catching chance? Not sure Swapnil got a hand near it in the end
flat outside off, crunching cut shot but Jacks is there to intercept a full stretch
tossed up and defended back down the track
edged... but it beats short third! Quick spin from a length and Shashank is seeking to cover the line, manages to divert it past the fielder on the edge of the ring despite a dive
flat on off, Shashank jumps out and blocks into the covers

miscued down the throat of long-on! The break has broken Rossouw's focus and he picks out the boundary-rider. Not a great ball, it sits up to be hit but there's no timing and it ends up being a simple take for Jacks a few yards in. Rossouw yelped in frustration moments after connecting, knowing he'd given it away

pushed through on the stumps, hint of spin for Karn as Rossouw attempts to reverse-sweep. The bowler appeals for lbw, but looks like it went straight up off the glove and Rossouw copped a blow to the throat
flat outside off, slapped to cover
obliterated into the stands! Tossed up on off stump and Rossouw swivels to slog-sweep with the spin, honking a big phat one over deep midwicket to send the crowd wild once more
dragged down and carved away through cover! Short and wide at 99kph, Rossouw picks his spot and doesn't bother to run. That's the PBKS 100 up
jitterbugs into the crease and pushes this through fast and flat on the stumps. Flicked behind square on the leg side
fired in straight and nudged off the pads
dug in and again the ball flies away behind the keeper! Swishy pull from Shashank and the 139kph pace helps takes the ball away fine for four
goes full and wide of the stumps, angles the bat for one behind point
full and launched, brings up a 21-ball fifty! Nice, hittable length, really, and Rossouw just steps into a thump over long-on. First half-century of the season for him
short and top-edged over the keeper! Runs away for four, can't do much about those
banged into the pitch and Rossouw chops the ball down towards cover point
fired down outside off, 108kph and Shashank drills his shot straight to the man in the ring at cover
quicker and tucked off the pads through backward square leg
tossed up and nudged through mid-on going back and across
into the pitch, 82kph and straightening on middle and off. Rossouw clips it out to deep midwicket
tossed up from over the wicket, flicked with the spin
round the wicket, angling in and worked through midwicket
boundary first ball! Ferguson errs by bowling a fullish ball that's sliding into his pads. Flicked into the gap and that's Punjab's second-highest powerplay of the season! Time out taken too.

Du Plessis, you beauty! From mid-off, he senses the ball will go over his head, so he turns with his face away from the action, and then tracks the ball coming over his shoulder, before diving full stretch to take a catch. Overpitched ball outside off and Bairstow tried to loft it over the infield, but the ball came off the bat's toe. Important breakthrough
length ball angling into leg stump. Bairstow plays a whippy shot off his knees, using the bowler's pace to help the ball to deep backward square leg!
full, 141kph ball just outside off. Goes for four as quickly as it got to Bairstow. Mowed over mid-on, generating enough power to clear the infielder.
length ball on middle and swung across the line, mistimes a leg-side swipe for a single
toe-ends a shot to the off side for a single
short and smoked over mid-on! Rossouw picks the slower ball and puts it away. A 16-run over
well-disguised slower ball, Bairstow has to wait and then readjust and ends up deflecting the ball off the face wide of DK
full on leg stump, flicked firmly off the pads but picks out short fine leg
full and straight, 137kph and Bairstow has to jam his bat down on it
fired full and wide down the leg side
full and pounded down the ground! YJB is motoring again, as he did the other night at Eden Gardens. Slot ball and he thumps it over extra cover
smashed into the crowd! Drops short and Bairstow simply brutalises a pull flat, 82m over deep midwicket!
short and munched! Kings getting this chase back on track. Rossouw connects with a powerhouse pound over deep midwicket
pitched up, 141kph outside off, drilled through long-off! Rossouw jumps out of the crease and crunches a drive past the diving du Plessis
length ball going across the bows, Rossouw throws the hands and fails to connect again
bashed down the ground, goes full this time and gets driven fiercely past mid-off
back of a length, swing and a miss!
shortish outside off, belted! Rossouw stands tall in the crease and hammers the ball through point
tickled to the fielder in the ring to finish a quiet over
dropped at backward point! Slower ball from Dayal and he had to wait for it, down on one knee... picked out Lomror, on as a sub, but the ball went up and then down, looping to safety over his head
another on-target inswinger, dug out to mid-on
pitched up, 136kph outside off and going away this time. Beats Rossouw's booming drive
full length, swerves in late but Rossouw picks up four! Jammed down and it skids off the inside edge, Siraj can't cut it off running around from deep backward square leg
pitched up in the channel, pushed for one coming across

punched to mid-on and there's a direct hit at the non-striker's end! Bairstow actually jumped to let the ball through, before it lit up the stumps. But he had grounded his foot over the line already, so all good
brilliant inswinging yorker, but Rossouw somehow keeps it out! Didn't know too much about it, left sprawling on the floor. Was it bat and pad? No review... given as runs
short outside off, Bairstow opens up the shoulders and slugs one out to deep backward point
just back of a length, 137kph and nipping a fraction. YJB gets a leading edge into the covers
short and blasted over midwicket! Leans back and hoicks a pull away for a two-bounce four
length ball, top of off stump. Defended
switches to round the wicket, full on off, crunched on the drive again! Positive from Rossouw, off the mark with back-to-back boundaries
smoked though the covers! Speared down outside off, 102kph but Rossouw is forward and snaps into a drive
